payload.title: The cqrs adapter's rule-1 bus guard matches only the class-name spelling CommandBus.execute( or QueryBus.execute(, so a controller that routes through an injected this.commandBus.execute( never satisfies it and gets a HIGH-cap controller_skips_command_query_bus finding
evidence: tools/aria-poc/cqrs_adapter.py:50 (_BUS_CALL_RE is case-sensitive and anchored on the class name, it cannot match an injected bus property)

tools/aria-poc/cqrs_adapter.py:128-130 (rule 1 fires on a Repository/DataSource/EntityManager mention plus any this.<x>.update/find/save call and no bus match; the last term is always true for injected-bus code)
tools/aria-adapters/cqrs-adapter.tool.json:33 (the manifest premise says the controller does not route the operation through CommandBus or QueryBus, which the regex cannot decide)
apps/admin-api-service/src/tenant/tenant.controller.ts:170 (the repository's own bus call is this.queryBus.execute()
apps/farm-service/src/batch/controllers/batch.controller.ts:236 (this.commandBus.execute( again; no controller in scope writes the static spelling)
tools/aria-poc/invariants/test_adapter_scope_narrow.py:342-348 (the only cqrs behaviour test exercises rule 2; no test or fixture contains any bus call)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md layer rule 1 (Controller -> Service -> Command/Query Bus): the detector must tell a controller that uses the bus from one that skips it; the manifest premise is not decidable by the regex.
payload.notes: Run on the revision's cqrs_adapter.scan() with a synthetic controller that imports DataSource, injects CommandBus, calls `this.commandBus.execute(new CreateCmd())` and `this.svc.update(1)`: it reports controller_skips_command_query_bus at the update line, while a file that writes the static form `CommandBus.execute(` is silent. Over the 92 production controllers in scope no file contains the static spelling, so the guard is dead code; no verdict differs today only because the two controllers that use buses do not name Repository. A controller that adopts the bus (the target architecture) and also names DataSource or Repository gets a false HIGH finding, because the regex looks at `this.<x>.update(` without checking that x is a repository. Close condition: Make the guard match the injected bus (for example `\b(?:command|query)Bus\.execute\s*\(` case-insensitively or by the constructor parameter type) and add a cqrs adapter test where a controller with `this.commandBus.execute(` and a DataSource type reference must produce no controller_skips_command_query_bus finding while the same file without the bus call still does. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 2b). Verified at head b2259fe03f of open pull request #2151; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
